title: Leonida Platinum — offline trophy guide and tracker
listNote: Official list of 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Guide text, roadmap stages and missable flags are original to this guide and are built from the official descriptions.
sourcesNote: Name, description and grade for every trophy: Exophase, Grand Theft Auto VI PSN trophy list, cross-checked against PSNProfiles, Grand Theft Auto VI trophy page (43531). Counts such as 42 Shooting Range challenges and 500 choices: PSNProfiles progress targets. Strategy wording: this guide's own advice from the official description; no location is stated as fact unless the official description names it.

roadmap.name: Landfall
roadmap.summary: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish Chapter 1. Have the Ocean Beach cocktail early, while you are first exploring the beachfront, and learn the tracker: tick trophies off as the story hands them to you.

roadmap.name: Vice City Opens Up
roadmap.summary: Clear Chapters 2 and 3, including The Cartel Heist and Child's Play. Sample every activity type once as it unlocks so Master of None is out of the way, and try one arcade game.

roadmap.name: The Chapter 4 Push
roadmap.summary: Finish Chapter 4 and the big set-piece missions Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory. Start chipping at the 250 stunts whenever you drive between missions.

roadmap.name: Endgame and One-Off Moments
roadmap.summary: Before the final mission, pause at the flagged one-off moments: the unscheduled VCIA departure, the showroom escape, the partnership moment and the choice-driven trophies. Keep a manual save before story choices so a missed branch costs minutes, not a replay. Then finish the final mission.

roadmap.name: Strangers, Freaks and Friends
roadmap.summary: Work through every stranger strand to its final mission: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus Bret's hunt. Eight finished strands also complete Strangers & Freaks.

roadmap.name: The Leonida Checklist
roadmap.summary: The long counters: Shooting Range golds, drone races, 20 race wins, meditation spots, card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 50 challenges, 100 vehicles, all 52 areas, all garages and the Scooter Bros registrations. Use the in-app counters so progress is never a guess.

roadmap.name: Free-Roam Finish
roadmap.summary: Everything left is free-roam work: partner crimes, robberies, bowling, the strange event, money targets and clean-up combat trophies. Close out 100 percent completion, and the platinum follows automatically.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself. It unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so never chase it directly: work the roadmap from stage 1 to stage 7 and use the tracker percentage as your real progress bar. If you finish the story first, everything left on the list is free-roam or checklist work, and nothing else on the list can lock you out of this one.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies
Let the platinum pop automatically
Check the tracker reads 55 of 55
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Route: this guide's roadmap, stages 1-7.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Play the prologue-style opener at the very start of a new game and follow its objectives to the end; there is no fail state that can cost you the trophy, and it pops as the mission wraps up. Because it is the first mission, starting the campaign at all puts you on the road to it.
steps: Start a new game
Play Gone Fishing to its final objective
Let the mission complete
trophies.sources: Official description names the mission: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Keep following the main mission markers after Gone Fishing and the chapter closes on its own; chapter trophies like this one cannot be missed, because the campaign cannot advance past the chapter without completing it. Tick it off when the Chapter 2 missions open up.
steps: Finish Gone Fishing
Complete every Chapter 1 story mission
Advance into Chapter 2
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own, from the official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2, asterisks and all, exactly as PlayStation prints the name. As with every chapter trophy here it is unmissable: the story only moves forward through it. Use Chapter 2 to start sampling side activities as they unlock, so the activity trophies later in the list are already warmed up.
steps: Complete every Chapter 2 story mission
Advance into Chapter 3
trophies.sources: Official name (with asterisks) and description: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Keep clearing main missions and it pops when the chapter ends. By this point the map and most activity types should be open, which is the natural moment to finish Master of None by trying anything you have not touched yet.
steps: Complete every Chapter 3 story mission
Advance into Chapter 4
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter before the endgame. It cannot be missed. After this chapter the flagged one-off moments in stage 4 of the roadmap matter most, so make a manual save when Chapter 4 closes and keep it until the credits roll.
steps: Complete every Chapter 4 story mission
Make a manual save before the endgame
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: One of only two golds on the list, for completing the final mission. Before you start it, clear the stage 4 flags in this guide: the choice and one-off trophies clustered around the endgame are the only story-adjacent risks, and a manual save before the point of no return makes each of them cheap to retry. The mission itself is unmissable; finishing the campaign earns it.
steps: Clear the stage 4 missable flags
Save before the final mission
Complete the final mission
trophies.sources: Official description and gold grade: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own, from the official description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run, an early errand in the campaign. Accept the mission when it is offered, drive its route and finish its final objective. Single-mission story trophies like this one pop on mission completion and cannot be skipped, because the campaign routes through them.
steps: Accept Breakfast Run when offered
Finish its objectives
Complete the mission
trophies.sources: Official description names the mission: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist, the first big score of the campaign. Play the heist through its setup and finale as the story presents them; the trophy is for completion, not for a clean escape or a target take, so a messy finale still counts. It is unmissable while following the main missions.
steps: Play The Cartel Heist from the story
Finish the heist finale
Complete the mission
trophies.sources: Official description names the mission: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. Follow the main story until the mission appears, play it to the end, and the trophy pops on completion. Like the other named-mission trophies it is a campaign waypoint rather than a skill test, so no special preparation is needed.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story
Complete the mission
trophies.sources: Official description names the mission: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. It arrives in the Chapter 4 stretch of the campaign; play it through and the trophy follows completion. Nothing in the official description asks for a medal, a time or a no-damage run, so treat it as a story beat and move on.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story
Complete the mission
trophies.sources: Official description names the mission: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown, the airport-authority mission. Do not confuse it with Catch Me If You Can, which asks for an unscheduled departure at the same airport and is flagged separately in this guide. Finish VCIA Takedown as part of the campaign and this one pops on completion, unmissable.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story
Complete the mission
trophies.sources: Official description names the mission and VCIA: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory. Play the operation to its end as the campaign presents it. It is a completion trophy with no extra condition in its official description, so it cannot be missed on a normal story run.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story
Complete the mission
trophies.sources: Official description names the mission: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold, and the real spine of the platinum: reach 100 percent completion on the game's own completion tally. Almost everything else on this list feeds it, so leave it for stage 7 and work the in-game completion checklist against this tracker side by side. When the tally stalls in the high nineties, the usual leftovers are one activity type never tried, a stranger strand left mid-way, or a counter a few short of its total; the filters in this app isolate each of those groups.
steps: Clear story, strangers and activities first
Compare the in-game completion tally with this tracker
Hunt the last missing items by filter group
trophies.sources: Official description and gold grade: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: A silver counter trophy: complete 250 stunts. Start it early, in stage 3, rather than grinding it at the end: take ramps, jumps and airtime opportunities whenever a drive crosses one, and let story travel do most of the work. Use the counter in this tracker after each session; if a dedicated grind is still needed late, loop a stunt-dense route and re-attempt clean landings, since only completed stunts advance the tally.
steps: Take stunt jumps during normal travel from stage 3 on
Track the count in this app
Grind a repeatable jump route for any remainder
trophies.sources: Official description and count (250): Exophase PSN list; count target cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once; the starter data and the completion tally point to nine activity types. You do not need to win or finish most of them, only to genuinely start each type once. The efficient route is to sample each type the first time the map offers it, from stage 2 onward, and to use this tracker's counter to name the types still untried before you go hunting.
steps: Start one activity of each type as types unlock
Record each type tried in the counter
Find the last untried type via the completion tally
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase PSN list. Type count (9): PSNProfiles progress data as carried in the official-list starter data. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: A silver skill trophy: gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each challenge's target pattern with a few silver runs first, then push for gold once the layout is familiar; accuracy almost always beats speed on a fresh challenge. Keep the counter honest in this tracker, golds only, and revisit stubborn challenges with a rested run rather than chaining frustrated retries.
steps: Unlock the Shooting Range challenges
Learn each layout, then chase gold
Log each gold in the counter until it reads 42
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase PSN list. Challenge count (42): PSNProfiles progress targets. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location, 14 in all. A win is needed, not just a start, so learn each course with one exploratory run, then race it properly. Clear locations region by region so no single course is forgotten, and log each won location in the counter as you go.
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location
Learn the course, then win it
Log wins until the counter reads 14
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase PSN list. Location count (14): PSNProfiles progress data as carried in the official-list starter data. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different does the work here: repeating a favourite race twenty times does not finish it. Spread wins across the race types the game offers, bring a vehicle suited to each class, and record each distinct win in the counter so the last few are a short, known list rather than a memory test.
steps: Win a first race of each available type
Keep winning new races, not repeats
Log distinct wins until the counter reads 20
trophies.sources: Official description and count (20 different races): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges can be retried, so this is a patience trophy rather than a missable one: learn the challenge's catch rules on a first attempt, then fish it cleanly on the next. If the challenge only appears at certain spots or times, the official description gives no location, so this guide claims none; find Cal's challenge through the fishing activity markers and keep retrying until you out-fish him.
steps: Unlock fishing and find Cal's challenge
Learn its scoring on a first try
Beat Cal on a clean attempt
trophies.sources: Official description names Cal and the fishing challenge: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own; no location is asserted because the official description names none.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, any one. Walk up to an arcade cabinet when you first pass one, in stage 2, pick the shortest game on offer and play it to its actual end rather than quitting at a game-over screen. It is one of the cheapest trophies on the list and an easy early tick for Master of None as well.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet
Play one game through to completion
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Stranger strands are chains: each mission for Andy unlocks the next, so work his marker whenever it appears and do not leave the strand half-done when the story pulls you away. The trophy is for the strand's last mission specifically, not for meeting Andy, so keep going until his story actually closes.
steps: Start Andy's strand when his marker appears
Complete each of his missions in order
Finish his final mission
trophies.sources: Official description names Andy and his final mission: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand by completing his final mission. As with every named stranger on this list, the strand is a chain of missions and only the last one earns the trophy. Clear Kenton's markers as they appear in stage 5 and the strand also counts toward the eight strands Strangers & Freaks requires.
steps: Start Kenton's strand
Complete his missions in order
Finish his final mission
trophies.sources: Official description names Kenton and his final mission: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Keep Billy's chain moving whenever his marker is up; strands left idle are the most common reason the 100 percent tally stalls late. Only the final mission pops the trophy, so play the strand to its true end.
steps: Start Billy's strand
Complete his missions in order
Finish his final mission
trophies.sources: Official description names Billy and his final mission: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: A silver umbrella trophy: complete eight full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each give you one, and Bret's work leads toward another, so finishing every named strand in stage 5 gets you most of the way; the counter in this tracker should be updated per finished strand, not per mission. A strand counts only when it is finished, which is why the five final-mission trophies pair with this one.
steps: Finish each named stranger strand
Log each finished strand in the counter
Complete any remaining strands until it reads 8
trophies.sources: Official description and count (8 strands, state of Leonida): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Work Randy's chain in stage 5 alongside the other strangers, and remember the trophy tracks the strand's end, not its start: if Randy still has a marker on the map, this trophy is still outstanding.
steps: Start Randy's strand
Complete his missions in order
Finish his final mission
trophies.sources: Official description names Randy and his final mission: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Same rule as the other stranger finals: follow Tyrone's markers through the whole chain in stage 5. Completing this strand also moves Strangers & Freaks and the 100 percent tally, so it is worth three checks in this tracker at once.
steps: Start Tyrone's strand
Complete his missions in order
Finish his final mission
trophies.sources: Official description names Tyrone and his final mission: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida, 18 spots in total. Treat it as a collectible sweep: meditate the first time you pass any spot rather than saving them all for the end, and log each one in the counter with a note of its area so duplicates are obvious. The official description names no spots, so this guide invents none; sweep region by region in stage 6 and let the counter, not memory, say what is left.
steps: Meditate at each spot when first found
Log spots in the counter by area
Sweep remaining regions until it reads 18
trophies.sources: Official description: Exophase PSN list. Spot count (18): PSNProfiles progress data as carried in the official-list starter data. Advice: this guide's own; no spot locations are asserted.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's work when his strand offers it and follow his hunt through to the unique animal itself; a normal hunt does not substitute. The official description names Bret and the unique animal but no species or place, so this guide claims neither: follow Bret's own markers and instructions in game, in stage 5 with the other stranger work.
steps: Take Bret's hunting work
Follow his strand to the unique animal
Complete the hunt
trophies.sources: Official description names Bret and the unique animal: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own; no species or location is asserted.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: A silver collectible trophy: complete three full Collectible Card sets. Sets, not loose cards, are the unit, so pick three sets and finish them completely instead of spreading pickups thinly across every set. Grab cards whenever exploration passes them, keep a per-set note in this tracker, and focus the stage 6 sweep on the sets closest to done.
steps: Collect cards during normal exploration
Choose the three fullest sets to finish
Complete sets until the counter reads 3
trophies.sources: Official description and count (3 sets): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: A silver sweep trophy: use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Different locations are the whole game here, so build the habit early: whenever you arrive somewhere new, do it once and add one to the counter. In stage 6, work district by district so the last locations are a short sweep of untouched areas rather than a hundred maybes.
steps: Use WAiNK It once in each new location
Log the running total in the counter
Sweep untouched districts until it reads 100
trophies.sources: Official description and count (100 locations): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges accumulate across almost everything else on this list, so check the counter before grinding: most players following the roadmap will be close by stage 6 without trying. Finish the remainder with the shortest repeatable challenges you have already learned, and log completions as they land.
steps: Let challenges accumulate through the roadmap
Check the counter in stage 6
Repeat short known challenges for the remainder
trophies.sources: Official description and count (50): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a four-star wanted level, then lose it and fully escape the heat. Both halves matter: raising the stars is easy, but the trophy needs the clean getaway with your partner still with you. Plan the escape before the crime: a fast car, a route away from patrols, and somewhere to lie low until the stars drain. It is repeatable in free roam, so a failed escape costs only another attempt.
steps: Ride with your partner in free roam
Raise the wanted level to 4 stars
Break line of sight and escape until the heat clears
trophies.sources: Official description (4 stars, partner, escape): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back to back with your partner, without losing your wanted level in between. This is the mirror image of Hot Together: here the heat must stay on you for the whole chain, so pick three shops close together, keep moving between them, and never hide long enough for the stars to drop. Do it in free roam in stage 7, with a fast car staged outside the first shop.
steps: Pick three nearby shops and ride with your partner
Rob the first and keep the wanted level alive
Rob the second and third without the heat dropping
trophies.sources: Official description (3 shops, back-to-back, partner, wanted level kept): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery comes from encountering and using the game's vehicle variety, so the cheap method is variety itself: drive something different whenever the chance appears, swap cars between missions, and sample boats and aircraft when activities offer them. Log broad progress in the counter; the last undiscovered models are usually the rare spawns, so late-game variety in rich districts finishes it.
steps: Drive a different vehicle whenever one is offered
Sample land, sea and air vehicles
Log progress until the counter reads 100
trophies.sources: Official description and count (100 vehicles): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Set the attempt up rather than hoping for it: start a fight against a group of at least five, position so all of them are reachable in one activation, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them without letting it lapse. Any busy combat encounter in free roam or a replayable fight will do; failed attempts cost nothing.
steps: Find a group of five or more enemies
Line them up before activating
Trigger Combat Focus and drop all five in one use
trophies.sources: Official description (5 enemies, single Combat Focus): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: FLAGGED MISSABLE by this guide, from the official wording: an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport from VCIA Takedown, reads as a one-off story moment rather than a free-roam action. While you are at VCIA during the story, look for the chance to leave outside the script: take an aircraft or vehicle out when the mission is not telling you to. Keep a manual save before the VCIA story beats in stage 4 so that if the moment passes, reloading costs minutes. If a free-roam method exists, this flag costs you nothing; if it does not, the save does.
steps: Save before the VCIA story missions
At VCIA, depart without being told to
Reload the save and retry if the moment passes
trophies.sources: Official description names VCIA and the unscheduled departure: Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Missable flag: this guide's inference from that wording, labelled as such.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke, not an instruction: it gets kinda hot in these Rhinos, Rhino being the series' tank. Read plainly, this is the tank trophy: get into or up against a Rhino when the game puts one in front of you, most plausibly during heavy wanted levels or late combat encounters, and survive the encounter the description hints at. The official list gives no precise trigger, so this guide asserts none: when a Rhino appears, engage with it directly instead of fleeing, and keep a save nearby in case the moment is rarer than it looks.
steps: Watch for a Rhino tank in heavy encounters
Engage with it directly when one appears
Survive the encounter
trophies.sources: Official description (the Rhino line): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Reading of it: this guide's own, labelled as an inference because the description states no explicit condition.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole requirement: plan entry and exit before you start, avoid raising attention inside, and leave without a detection state ever triggering. If an attempt is spotted, do not finish the robbery out of stubbornness; walk away, let things cool down, and run it again cleanly. It is a free-roam repeatable, so patience beats force.
steps: Choose a jewelry store and plan a quiet route
Rob it while staying undetected
Escape without detection; retry clean if spotted
trophies.sources: Official description (jewelry store, no detection): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: A silver crime counter: rob five bank vaults and escape each time. A vault only counts with the getaway, so stage a fast car, plan the route out before going in, and treat each bank as two jobs: the robbery and the escape. Log each clean vault in the counter; five separate successful runs finish it, and failed escapes simply do not advance the tally.
steps: Rob a bank vault
Escape the response completely
Repeat and log until the counter reads 5
trophies.sources: Official description and count (5 vaults, with escape): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Stop or breach the truck, take what it carries, and then complete the second half people forget: a full escape. Have the getaway car ready before you start and break line of sight early. One clean truck finishes the trophy, so pick your moment in stage 7 free roam rather than forcing it during a mission.
steps: Find an armored truck in free roam
Rob it and take the haul
Escape until the heat clears
trophies.sources: Official description (armored truck, with escape): Exophase PSN list, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida, tracked as 52 areas. Exploration trophies finish themselves if you travel widely for the other checklist work, so leave the sweep for stage 6: compare the map against the counter, then deliberately visit the untouched areas, including the quiet corners no mission visits. Log areas as they register so the final gaps are named places, not guesses.
steps: Travel widely during stages 1-5
Compare the map with the counter in stage 6
Visit every remaining area until it reads 52
trophies.sources: Official description (all of Leonida): Exophase PSN list. Area count (52): PSNProfiles progress data as carried in the official-list starter data. Advice: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang, nine gangs in all. One robbery per gang is the requirement, so variety matters more than volume: when you rob an operation, note which gang owned it in this tracker, and deliberately target the gangs still missing. Sweep the missing gangs in stage 7 once the map and its territories are familiar.
steps: Rob an illegal operation and note its gang
Target operations of gangs still missing
Repeat until all 9 gangs are logged
trophies.sources: Official description (one operation per gang): Exophase PSN list. Gang count (9): PSNProfiles progress data as carried in the official-list starter data. Advice: this guide's own.

When a mission puts you inside a showroom with a vehicle, take the loud way out: drive through the showroom front rather than leaving on foot or by a marked exit. Keep the stage 4 habit of a manual save before set-piece missions, so a missed exit costs a reload, not a playthrough.

Line up a slow pass, swing as the target draws level, and make sure the hit lands from the vehicle rather than after stopping. It is repeatable anywhere with people and a car or bike, so experiment in stage 7 until the timing clicks.

Melee as you pass, without stopping

Keep the counter in this tracker in round thousands after each session; the total arrives naturally if every robbery and operation in stage 7 routes its marked take through your contacts.
